harmony-recovery hosts the emergency shard-0 in-place recovery tooling.
The preflight subcommand samples a validator database for recovery
eligibility without stopping the node and never writes to the database.
The metadata command group (scan, export-reference, audit-branch) derives
and audits the recovery target's validator metadata on a stopped node.

Usage:
  harmony-recovery [flags]
  harmony-recovery [command]

Available Commands:
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help        Help about any command
  metadata    Offline validator-metadata maintenance (scan, export-reference, audit-branch; stopped node required)
  preflight   Sample a shard-0 database for recovery target availability (never writes; node may keep running)

Flags:
  -h, --help      help for harmony-recovery
  -v, --version   version for harmony-recovery

Use "harmony-recovery [command] --help" for more information about a command.
